channel.title: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社)
channel.description: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社) is a growing real-life social community for expats in China. Founded by locals who know every corner of the country, we help global friends live a fun, connected and hassle-free life here — through themed parties, food crawls, sports leagues, hikes, language exchange and cultural workshops across Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu and 9 more cities.

item.title: Weekend Camping Trip — Guangzhou
item.description: Quarterly · Conghua District, Guangzhou (2 hours from downtown) · RMB 480 including tent, meals and transport. One night under the stars with a bonfire, BBQ dinner and a sunrise hike. Tents and sleeping bags provided; bring a warm layer and a torch.

item.title: International Potluck Dinner — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, last Friday · Yuexiu District, Guangzhou · Free for members / RMB 80 with one dish to share. Bring a dish from home, taste twenty others. The fastest way to make friends in a new city, and the reason most of our Guangzhou members joined in the first place.

item.title: Baiyun Mountain Sunrise Hike — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, fourth Sunday · Baiyun Mountain, Guangzhou · RMB 60 including breakfast. An early start, a steady climb and breakfast on the summit with a view over the whole city. Beginner-friendly pace with regular stops.

item.title: Dumpling Making Class — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, fourth Saturday · Haizhu District, Guangzhou · RMB 128 including dinner. Knead, roll, fill and fold — Northern-style dumplings, Southern-style wontons and pan-fried potstickers. Dinner is whatever you made, plus a few extra plates from the kitchen.

item.title: Coastal Hike & Swim — Shenzhen
item.description: Monthly, third Sunday · Dapeng Peninsula, Shenzhen · RMB 180 including transport. A coastal trail with sea views, a swim stop and a seafood lunch. Around 10 km at an easy pace, suitable for regular walkers.

item.title: Calligraphy & Tea Ceremony Workshop
item.description: Monthly, third Saturday · Yuexiu District, Guangzhou · RMB 168 including materials. Brush calligraphy with a local teacher, then a guided tea tasting of six Chinese teas. You take your own framed character home.

item.title: Riverfront Pub Crawl — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, third Friday · Zhujiang New Town riverside, Guangzhou · RMB 100 with first drink included. Three venues along the Pearl River, starting with craft beer and finishing with a rooftop. Crew hosts keep the group moving and nobody drinks alone.

item.title: Liwan Street Food Crawl — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, second Saturday · Liwan District, Guangzhou · RMB 128 including tastings. A three-hour walk through the old city with a local guide: rice noodle rolls, clay pot rice, herbal jelly, egg tarts and the best roast meat in the district. Vegetarian route available on request.

item.title: Hotpot & Mahjong Night — Chengdu
item.description: Monthly, second Friday · Wuhou District, Chengdu · RMB 168 including hotpot. Sichuan hotpot with a spice-level guide for newcomers, followed by a Mahjong teaching table. You will learn at least three useful Sichuan phrases.

item.title: International Rooftop Mixer — Shanghai
item.description: Monthly, second Thursday · Jing’an District, Shanghai · RMB 150 including two drinks. A relaxed networking evening for newcomers and long-timers: name tags, conversation prompts, zero sales pitches. Roughly half the room is usually new to Shanghai.

item.title: Cantonese & Mandarin Language Exchange — Guangzhou
item.description: Weekly, every Wednesday · Zhujiang New Town, Tianhe District, Guangzhou · Free for members / RMB 60 drop-in. Two hours of structured language exchange: 30 minutes Mandarin, 30 minutes Cantonese, then open mingling. Bring a notebook, leave with a tandem partner. All levels welcome, from absolute beginners to HSK 5.

item.title: Badminton Social Night — Guangzhou
item.description: Weekly, every Tuesday · Tianhe Sports Centre area, Guangzhou · RMB 40 court share. Four courts, mixed levels, rotating partners. Beginners get a 15-minute warm-up coaching slot before open play. Rackets available to borrow.

item.title: Survival Chinese Crash Course (Online)
item.description: Every two weeks, Monday · Online · Free for members. Ninety minutes covering the phrases that actually matter in the first month: ordering food, taking a taxi, asking for a receipt, handling a landlord conversation and reading a rental contract.

item.title: Dim Sum Making Workshop — Guangzhou
item.description: Monthly, first Sunday · Yuexiu District, Guangzhou · RMB 198 including lunch. Learn to fold shrimp dumplings (har gow) and make steamed buns with a Cantonese chef, then eat everything you made. Includes a short tea ceremony introduction.

item.title: Great Wall Trekking Day — Beijing
item.description: Monthly, first Saturday · Departure from Dongzhimen, Beijing · RMB 280 including transport and lunch. A full-day hike on a restored-but-quiet section of the Wall, with transport, a local guide and lunch in a village restaurant. Moderate fitness required; about 8 km of walking.

item.title: Guangzhou expat living guide
item.description: A practical living guide for expats in Guangzhou: visas and residence permits, apartment rental and district prices, banking and WeChat Pay, healthcare, transport, Cantonese food, language and the social scene.
